platform_discovery_surface_label: Example platform search, homepage, and browse-feed discovery posture for official voter-information media
delivery_role_note: The service reviews upstream platform discovery surfaces that can place official voter-information media in front of the public before the written/help lane or media page itself, so ranked search or recommendation state stays subordinate to the current written/help route rather than quietly becoming a shadow router.

reviewed_discovery_contexts.context_note: Reviewed whether search-result ranking, filtering, labels, and result-card cues can place official election media in front of the voter before the current written/help route.
Reviewed whether homepage rows, browse feeds, or recommendation shelves can surface older, upcoming, replay, or mixed-source artifacts in ways that overclaim currentness.
Reviewed whether followed-channel or mixed-feed discovery remains distinct from durable follow/reminder state and from the current written/help route.
Reviewed whether organization or workspace video-homepage discovery surfaces blend resume-state and newly shared items in ways that could feel like an official current-answer map.
Reviewed which downstream surfaces discovery can open, such as upcoming-event shells, replay pages, or collection routes, and kept upstream discovery distinct from those downstream controls.

platform_discovery_boundary_note: Platform search results, homepage rows, and browse feeds are treated as discovery/routing context rather than proof that the surfaced media is the controlling operational answer.
ranking_and_personalization_note: The service records whether search ranking, sorting, history, or feed/personalization signals materially change which official media can appear first, rather than pretending that discovery order is office-controlled.
mixed_scope_adjacency_note: If official media can appear beside nonofficial, historical, upcoming, or replay content in discovery surfaces, that adjacency is reviewed so mixed presentation does not overclaim scope or currentness.
card_level_currentness_note: Titles, thumbnails, live/replay labels, and upload-age cues on search-result cards or homepage rows are reviewed so prominence does not silently substitute for explicit current written/help recovery.
current_help_recovery_note: When a voter reaches official media through platform discovery, the route still points back to the current official page, notice, FAQ/help entry, or named office contact before the voter acts on time-sensitive guidance.
